channel.title: Paksh: Sports
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.description: Max Verstappen publicly criticized and mocked George Russell following the Las Vegas Grand Prix, stating Russell was "so far below my level." The comments came after an incident during the race where Russell was involved in a collision… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
